messages:
Mika: Heads up — seit ~01:00 UTC we've seen p95/p99 gen latency drift in usw1, correlating with a big sustained batch run from tenant 'ml-prep'. KV-cache eviction spiked and egress per-host looks elevated. Can we do a temporary carveout or routing change to isolate them?

Sanjay: I see the same on the probe dashboards. KV cache regen rate + tokenized tail latency both went up. Looks like they burst to many warm slots and are pushing NIC queues.

Carmen: Agree. Short mitigation options: (1) quick dedicated slice (2 GPUs, capped egress) for ml-prep, (2) soft-quarantine on noisy hosts, or (3) transient routing to preemptible pool. Carveout is fastest.

Mika: Carveout sounds good. We should keep it tiny and put an egress cap. Also add an automatic fallback so app still serves if carveout fills.

Carmen: Proposed command (rwdctl):
```
rwdctl alloc carveout create --tenant ml-prep --pool dedicated-usw1-burstshield --gpus 2 --egress 200mbps --fallback route=shared,policy=hedge
```
That will create a small reserved slice + fallback routing.

Lia: I can apply that now and watch dashboards. Will add a 2-hour quick window then reevaluate.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4321: "ml-prep burst carveout + monitoring" and added runbook link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/noisy-tenant-mitigation

Sanjay: One additional note — if the carveout helps we should follow up with a policy: burst credits or scheduled background windows for big batch jobs. Otherwise this will keep repeating.

Lia: Patch applied, carveout is live. Watching p99 and kv-evictions.

Mika: Thanks. If p99 drops, leave the carveout for 4 hours then gradually drain back and reassess. Also tag product about tenant-side throttling options.

Lia: Initial telemetry: p99 down ~18%, kv-eviction rate reduced. Will leave up and post a short replay in 30/60/120 mins.

Carmen: :thumbsup: Once stable, let's open a short proposal: burst credits + explicit pre-warm contract for long-running batch tenants.

Mika: Filing follow-up doc in INF-4321. Thanks all.
